method.route: TCIA getSOPInstanceUIDs + getSingleImage, one middle slice per series; full DICOM header read with stop_before_pixels. No image volume was downloaded.

cohort.dropped_reason: only 8mm-thickness axial series with <40 slices plus localizers; too coarse for cardiac chamber segmentation

gate_1_vendor_strata.rule: >=2 vendor strata with n>=15 patients each

gate_2_continuous_spread.rule: meaningful spread on >=1 continuous acquisition parameter
gate_2_continuous_spread.verdict: PASS on slice thickness (8 levels, 0.625-5.0mm, 8x), tube current (64 levels) and in-plane spacing (55 levels)

vendor_x_thickness.note: associated but not collinear: thickness varies within both vendors (GE 0.625-5.0, SIEMENS 1.0-5.0)

contrast_field.verdict: ContrastBolusAgent is populated in only 21/81 primary series and disagrees with the series description in 17 more. Contrast must be modelled as a 3-level factor including 'unknown', not a binary.

kvp_vendor.verdict: kVp is ESTIMABLE: GE spans 120/140 and SIEMENS spans 120/130, so within-vendor contrasts exist. Corrected from an earlier draft that claimed non-identifiability. Confounding is partial: 130 kVp is SIEMENS-only and 140 kVp never SIEMENS, so report within-vendor contrasts with per-cell n rather than a pooled coefficient.
kvp_vendor.supersedes: earlier field 'kvp_nested_in_vendor' claiming the model was not identifiable

gate_4_test_retest.rule: Phase 3 was conditional on repeat scans existing
gate_4_test_retest.verdict: FAR EXCEEDS the plan's 5-10 pair expectation

overall_verdict: PROCEED to Phase 1. Both gate conditions met. The design should be restructured around the within-patient paired comparison (n=27-31 discordant patients) as PRIMARY rather than the between-patient regression, on power and confounding grounds.

artifact_corrections.defect: built with per-column groupby().first(), which skips NaN independently per column; for 7 patients whose primary series lacks ContrastBolusAgent it back-filled the value from a different series of the same patient, showing 28 populated where the primary series carry 21
artifact_corrections.scope: ContrastBolusAgent only; vendor, kVp, tube current, thickness, spacing, kernel, software version and series UID identical under whole-row selection (0 of 81 differing)

artifact_corrections.defect: header-coverage table captioned 'of 81 primary series' but carried the 573-series percentages (99/96/92%)
artifact_corrections.fix: both populations now reported separately; all fields are 100% in the 81 analysed patients

artifact_corrections.defect: claimed kVp was 'not identifiable' / nested in vendor and must be dropped as a free term
artifact_corrections.scope: design recommendation for the secondary between-patient model; primary paired endpoint unaffected
artifact_corrections.fix: verified full rank (5/5), max VIF 2.26; kVp retained with within-vendor contrasts reported and per-cell n stated
